scripts.deploy:website: bun run build:website && wrangler deploy --config apps/website/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.native:check: bun run native:ensure && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo check --workspace --locked && cargo test --workspace --locked && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.checks: bun run native:check && bun run native:benchmark && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format && bun run test
scripts.checks:fix: bun run lint:fix && bun run format:fix && bun run native:fix && bun run checks
